title: Personal Credit Cards: Tier Entry Thresholds and Secured Card Terms
content:
This page sets out, for every tier of Personal Credit Cards, the age band an applicant must fall within, the tiers that call for a cash security deposit or a particular deposit relationship, and the review point at which a secured card may move up.

## Entry thresholds by tier

Ages are counted in whole years completed at the time the application is taken.

| Tier | Youngest age accepted | Oldest age accepted | Security deposit held | Smallest deposit accepted | Other entry requirement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | 18 | no upper age | yes, matching the credit limit | 300.00 USD | deposit at or above the smallest amount |
| College Rewards Visa | 18 | 25 | no | not applicable | age within the band |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | 18 | no upper age | no | not applicable | none beyond age |
| Cash Rewards Visa | 18 | no upper age | no | not applicable | none beyond age |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 21 | no upper age | no | not applicable | none beyond age |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | 21 | no upper age | no | not applicable | the applicant holds Private Client Checking |

## Secured card progression

| Tier | Months after opening at which graduation is reviewed | Tier it graduates into |
|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | 8 | Cash Rewards Visa |
| Every other tier | not applicable | not applicable |

## Points of judgement

- **Is there an upper age for most tiers?** Only College Rewards Visa carries one; every other tier accepts any applicant at or above its youngest age.
- **What does the Secured Visa deposit secure?** A cash deposit equal to the card's credit limit is held for the life of the secured account, and no deposit below the smallest amount in the table is accepted.

> Hypothetical illustration: an applicant who has completed 20 years of age meets the age band of Secured Visa, College Rewards Visa, Platinum Low Rate Visa and Cash Rewards Visa, but not the band of Travel Rewards Visa Signature or Visa Infinite Private Client.
